environment.name: Sandbox
environment.description: All user stories target the OneShield sandbox environment. Tests are executed against this environment using Playwright automation via the pytest-bdd framework.
environment.credentials_source: .env file — PARTNER_NUM, USERNAMEE, PASSWORD (double-E to avoid Windows USERNAME clash)

description: As an agent, I want to create a complete Personal Auto new business policy from quote to bind so that the customer receives valid coverage.
The system should guide the agent through all required steps: new quote, customer creation, quote registration, quote summary, driver details, vehicle details, coverage selection, and policy binding.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can log in to the OneShield sandbox and navigate to Quotes
Agent can initiate a New Quote selecting the Agent role
All required pages (Customer, Quote Registration, Quote Summary, Driver, Vehicle, Coverage) are accessible in sequence
Completed quote results in a bound policy with a valid policy number
No underwriting referral is triggered for a clean risk profile
Policy summary page is displayed after binding
Test cases TC_ID_0001 and TC_ID_0011 complete end-to-end without errors

description: As an agent, I want to create a new individual customer record so that I can associate the customer with a Personal Auto quote.
The system should accept all required demographic fields, validate the ZIP code and address, and prevent duplicate customer creation.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can select CustomerType as 'Individual'
Agent can enter FirstName, LastName, DOB (MM/DD/YYYY format), PhoneNum (555-XXX-XXXX), and Email
Agent can enter Address, ZIP (01101), City (Springfield), and State (Massachusetts)
System accepts and saves the customer record successfully
Email field accepts dynamic timestamp-based format (name_{timestamp}@auto.com) to ensure uniqueness
System navigates to Quote Registration after customer creation
Invalid or missing required fields prevent progression

description: As an agent, I want to register a quote by selecting the producer, program, and effective date so that the policy is associated with the correct producer and starts on the right date.
The system should use today's date as the effective date and load the 'Personal Auto' program from the dropdown without ambiguity.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can select Producer 'Janis Irey' from the combobox
Agent can select Program 'Personal Auto' (exact match, no ambiguity with similar program names)
System waits for FieldProcessorServlet response after Program selection before enabling Effective Date
Effective date is calculated automatically from today's date
Agent can click Next to proceed to Quote Summary
Invalid effective dates (past dates, missing program) are rejected

description: As an agent, I want to complete the Quote Summary page by setting billing method and answering disclosure questions so that the quote is properly configured before driver and vehicle entry.
The system should allow the agent to indicate if the customer provided false/misleading information and if there is prior property damage.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can set Billing Method to 'Direct Billed' via combobox
Agent can answer 'False/Misleading Information' question (Yes/No radio)
Agent can answer 'Prior Damage Information' question (Yes/No radio)
When Damage Info is 'Yes', a text area for damage description becomes available
Agent can save the summary and navigate to Driver Info via the driver link
Driver info link uses the customer's first name for dynamic identification
FalseInfo and DamageInfo fields are mandatory for save to succeed

description: As an agent, I want to enter driver information including demographics and license details so that the underwriting engine can assess risk and apply appropriate rules.
The system should collect gender, marital status, driver status, employment, occupation, license status, and SR-22 flag for each driver.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can select Gender (Male/Female)
Agent can select MaritalStatus (Single/Married/Divorced/Widowed)
Agent can select DriverStatus as 'Active (rated)'
Agent can select EmploymentCategory (Employed/Unemployed/Retired/Student)
Agent can select Occupation (e.g., 'Day Care')
Agent can select LicenseStatus (Active License/Suspended/Revoked)
Agent can answer SR-22 'Certificate of Insurance Required?' (Yes/No)
Agent can optionally answer 'Defensive Driver Course completed in last 3 years' (Yes/No)
System saves driver info and enables navigation to Vehicle_1 link

description: As an agent, I want to enter vehicle details so that the system can properly rate the policy based on the vehicle being insured.
The system should support dependent dropdowns for Year/Make/Model and load vehicle specifications after model selection.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can select VehicleType (e.g., 'Private Passenger Auto')
Agent can select Year — system waits for FieldProcessorServlet after each selection
Agent can select Make — dependent on Year selection
Agent can select Model — dependent on Make selection
Agent can select Specification from XPath-matched dropdown
Agent can select VehicleUse (Pleasure/Commute/Business/Farm)
Agent can select Ownership (Owned/Leased/Financed)
For 'Owned' vehicles, Loss Payee fields are not shown
System saves vehicle info and enables navigation to Coverages section

description: As an agent, I want to add a Loss Payee for a leased or financed vehicle so that the lender is properly listed on the policy.
The system should conditionally show the Loss Payee form only when vehicle ownership is 'Leased' or 'Financed' and require both type and name fields.
acceptance_criteria: When Ownership is 'Leased', the Add Loss Payee button is displayed
When Ownership is 'Financed', the Add Loss Payee button is displayed
When Ownership is 'Owned', the Loss Payee section is not displayed
Agent can select LossPayeeType (Leased or Financed)
Agent can enter LossPayeeName (e.g., 'BMW Financial Services')
Loss Payee information is saved and associated with Vehicle_1
Missing Loss Payee for Leased/Financed vehicle prevents progression

description: As an agent, I want to select a coverage tier and rate the quote so that the system applies the correct premium and checks underwriting rules.
The system should support Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum coverage options and invoke the rating engine upon clicking Rate Quote.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can select PolicyCoverage: Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Platinum
System displays a loading spinner during coverage page load
Agent can click 'Rate Quote' button to invoke the rating engine
Rating engine completes without error for clean risk profiles
System detects UW referral conditions at three possible points: before coverage selection, during page load, and on Rate Quote click
Successful rating transitions agent to policy creation flow
All four coverage tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum) are tested across TC_ID_0001–TC_ID_0011

description: As an agent, I want to bind an approved Personal Auto policy so that the customer is covered under a confirmed policy number.
The system should sequence through Request Issue, Delivery Preferences, Billing Plan, and Verify Billing before completing the bind.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can click 'Request Issue' to initiate policy issuance
System navigates to Delivery Preferences page after Request Issue
Agent can proceed through Delivery Preferences by clicking Next
System navigates to Billing Plan page
Billing Plan is completed with PaymentPlan 'Pay In Full'
Agent can proceed to Verify Billing page
Agent can click Bind to complete policy binding
System displays policy summary with a valid policy number after binding
Loading masks are waited on after each step to ensure stability

description: As a underwriter, I want the system to automatically flag a policy for UW referral when the driver requires an SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance so that the risk is properly reviewed before binding.
The system should detect the SR-22 flag on the driver record and display the appropriate underwriting condition on the referral page.
acceptance_criteria: When SR22 field is set to 'Yes' on the driver record, the rating engine routes to the UW Referral page
The UW Referral page displays the condition: 'SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked'
The condition is visible in the Underwriting Issues grid with correct Asset, Type, and Condition columns
UW referral is triggered regardless of the driver's age or license status when SR-22 is 'Yes'
Clean profile with SR22='No' does NOT trigger this condition
Test cases UW_TC_001, UW_TC_013 validate isolated SR-22 triggering

metadata.uw_condition_text: SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked

description: As an underwriter, I want the system to automatically flag a policy for UW referral when the primary driver has a suspended or revoked license so that the risk is properly reviewed before binding.
The system should detect invalid license status on the driver record and display the appropriate underwriting condition.
acceptance_criteria: When LicenseStatus is 'Suspended', the rating engine routes to the UW Referral page
When LicenseStatus is 'Revoked', the rating engine routes to the UW Referral page
The UW Referral page displays the condition: 'driver license status that is revoked or suspended'
The condition appears in the Underwriting Issues grid
Active License status does NOT trigger this condition when SR-22 and age are clean
Test cases UW_TC_002 (Suspended) and UW_TC_004 (Revoked) validate isolated license triggering

metadata.uw_condition_text: driver license status that is revoked or suspended

description: As an underwriter, I want the system to automatically flag a policy for UW referral when any driver is under 25 years of age so that the risk is properly reviewed before binding.
The system should compute the driver's age on the policy effective date and trigger referral if the driver will be younger than 25.
acceptance_criteria: When a driver's DOB places them under 25 on the policy effective date, the rating engine routes to the UW Referral page
The UW Referral page displays the condition: 'All drivers under 25 years of age'
Age boundary is: EffectiveDate minus 25 years minus 6 days
Driver born one day after the cutoff (24y 364d) triggers the condition
Driver born on the cutoff date (exactly 25) does NOT trigger this condition
Test cases UW_TC_003 (age 21), UW_TC_011 (age 18), UW_TC_014 (age 17y 364d) validate the age rule
UW_TC_014 uses today's effective date to test the minimum age boundary

metadata.uw_condition_text: All drivers under 25 years of age

description: As an underwriter, I want the system to flag multiple simultaneous UW conditions when a driver is both under 25 and requires an SR-22 so that all risk factors are captured in a single referral.
The system should list at least 2 conditions in the UW Referral grid for combined risk profiles.
acceptance_criteria: When SR22='Yes' AND driver age < 25, the UW Referral page is displayed
The grid shows at minimum 2 conditions: SR-22 condition AND under-25 condition
Both condition texts are present: 'SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked' and 'All drivers under 25 years of age'
Test case UW_TC_005 (age 20, SR-22=Yes) validates this combined scenario
Conditions appear as separate rows in the Underwriting Issues grid

uw_condition_texts: SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked
All drivers under 25 years of age

description: As an underwriter, I want the system to flag multiple simultaneous UW conditions when a driver has an SR-22 requirement combined with a suspended or revoked license so that both risk factors are captured.
The system should list at least 2 conditions in the UW Referral grid for this severe combined profile.
acceptance_criteria: When SR22='Yes' AND LicenseStatus='Suspended', at least 2 UW conditions are flagged
When SR22='Yes' AND LicenseStatus='Revoked', at least 2 UW conditions are flagged
SR-22 condition text present: 'SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked'
License condition text present: 'driver license status that is revoked or suspended'
Test case UW_TC_006 (SR-22 + Suspended) validates this scenario
Test case UW_TC_012 (SR-22 + Revoked) validates the most severe license/compliance combo

uw_condition_texts: SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked
driver license status that is revoked or suspended

description: As an underwriter, I want the system to flag all three UW conditions simultaneously when a driver is under 25, requires an SR-22, and has a revoked license — the highest-risk profile — so that every risk factor is captured in the referral.
The system should list at least 3 conditions in the UW Referral grid for the triple-risk profile.
acceptance_criteria: When SR22='Yes' AND LicenseStatus='Revoked' AND driver age < 25, all 3 UW conditions fire
The grid shows at minimum 3 conditions
SR-22 condition present: 'SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked'
License condition present: 'driver license status that is revoked or suspended'
Age condition present: 'All drivers under 25 years of age'
DamageInfo='Yes' is also set in this scenario, providing a damage description
Test case UW_TC_007 (age 22, SR-22=Yes, Revoked) validates the triple-risk scenario

uw_condition_texts: SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked
driver license status that is revoked or suspended
All drivers under 25 years of age

description: As an underwriter, I want to validate the age boundary condition for the under-25 UW rule so that the system correctly includes or excludes drivers at exactly 25 years of age on the effective date.
The system must apply the exact cutoff: EffectiveDate minus 25 years minus 6 days.
acceptance_criteria: Driver born exactly on the cutoff date (25 years and 6 days before effective date) does NOT trigger the under-25 condition
Driver born one day after the cutoff (24 years 364 days on effective date) DOES trigger the under-25 condition
The boundary is computed per-effective-date, not a fixed calendar date
Today's effective date validates boundary behavior for same-day policies
Boundary test UW_BOUNDARY_25_UNDER confirms the trigger fires correctly
Boundary test UW_BOUNDARY_25_EXACT confirms no false positive at age exactly 25

description: As an underwriter, I want to verify that a clean-risk Personal Auto applicant is processed straight-through to policy bind without any UW referral so that low-risk customers are not unnecessarily delayed.
The system should route clean profiles directly from the rating engine to the policy creation flow.
acceptance_criteria: Driver with Active License, SR22='No', and age >= 25 does not trigger any UW condition
After clicking Rate Quote, the system proceeds directly to Request Issue without displaying a UW Referral page
Policy binding completes successfully for a clean profile
Negative test UW_NEG_SR22 validates that no SR-22 flag results in no referral
Negative test UW_NEGATIVE_CLEAN validates the fully-clean profile scenario

description: As an underwriter, I want to validate UW referral for drivers under 25 with a leased vehicle so that both the age risk and the loss payee requirement are properly captured.
The system should display the under-25 UW condition while still requiring loss payee information for the leased vehicle.
acceptance_criteria: Driver under 25 with a leased vehicle triggers the under-25 UW condition
Loss Payee fields (Type + Name) are required and filled before rating
UW Referral page shows: 'All drivers under 25 years of age'
Loss payee data (LossPayeeType, LossPayeeName) is correctly saved to the vehicle record
Test case UW_TC_008 (age under 25, Ownership=Leased) validates this combined scenario

uw_condition_texts: All drivers under 25 years of age

description: As an underwriter, I want to validate UW referral for an SR-22 driver with a leased vehicle so that both the certificate of insurance requirement and the loss payee obligation are properly handled.
The system should display the SR-22 UW condition while also capturing loss payee information for the leased vehicle.
acceptance_criteria: SR-22='Yes' driver with a leased vehicle triggers the SR-22 UW condition
Loss Payee fields (Type + Name) are required and correctly captured
UW Referral page shows: 'SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked'
Loss payee data is saved and associated with the vehicle record
Test case UW_TC_010 (SR-22=Yes, Ownership=Leased) validates this combined scenario

uw_condition_texts: SR-22 / Certificate of Insurance Indicator is checked

description: As an agent, I want to test vehicle use variations (Pleasure, Commute, Business, Farm) across coverage tiers so that the rating engine correctly handles all vehicle use and coverage combinations.
The system should accept all valid VehicleUse values and rate the policy accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can select VehicleUse: Pleasure — standard personal use rating applies
Agent can select VehicleUse: Commute — commuter-rated premium applies
Agent can select VehicleUse: Business — business-use rating applies
Agent can select VehicleUse: Farm — farm vehicle rating applies
Each VehicleUse works with all four coverage tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum
Test cases TC_ID_0001 through TC_ID_0011 cover VehicleUse and coverage tier combinations
No system errors occur for any valid VehicleUse + PolicyCoverage combination
